dialogues.speaker: Komakata
dialogues.text: Come, try your hand at Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Sure thing! Enjoy the brand-new version of Theater Mechanicus! You won't be disappointed!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: In short, it is a game that can be played on a board. It was first invented by Ms. Ruijin from Liyue.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, according to Ms. Ruijin, I'm a local representative of Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: After I obtained... umm... the distribution rights, Ms. Ruijin sent me a complete set of Theater Mechanicus and the business model that goes with it.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: According to Ms. Ruijin, I am not her only overseas distributor. She must've made a lot of money from the distribution fees...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: However, I've prepared a brand-new gameplay. Maybe it'll be even better than Ms. Ruijin's original version of Theater Mechanicus... Ahem...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: *sigh* Ms. Ruijin really does have a good business sense. If only I could be like her...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, come back later when you have the time.

dialogues.speaker: Komakata
dialogues.text: Come, try your hand at the all-new version of Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: The "Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Brilliance" won't let you down!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: It's a tabletop game from Liyue, and a very interesting one, too!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: The original inventor of the game is Ms. Ruijin from Liyue, and she gave me the overseas franchising rights to the game, such that I'd be able to distribute it in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Ms. Ruijin originally had quite a few overseas franchise owners, but I seem to be the most stable of the lot.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I actually haven't heard from the others in a long time. Perhaps they've all given up due to a lack of profits.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: As for me, I'm just more focused on how Theater Mechanicus plays. I even tried to come up with a totally new game mode a while back.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I later discovered that my designs coincidentally lined up with the new ideas that Ms. Ruijin was implementing. But as it turns out, that just helped us hit it off all the more!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: In any case, the two of us will stay in touch and improve Theater Mechanicus, releasing regular updates for our customers!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A well-qualified franchise owner indeed.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Thanks!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, come back and play often, alright?

choices.text: So, there's this "big shot" here at the Irodori Festival...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Well, aren't you well-informed? Actually, you've probably met that big shot too, I'll bet!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: So what happened is that Ms. Ruijin did try to get a buy-in from the Feiyun Commerce Guild in the beginning, but they didn't seem all that interested.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: But the guild's second young master had quite the unique perspective and a real head for business, and so he wanted to see if Theater Mechanicus was a worthwhile investment.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Of course, Ms. Ruijin wasn't actually done preparing a new event yet, and there was no way we could start another round of Theater Mechanicus in Liyue on short notice.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: But when the young master heard from Ms. Ruijin that I would be promoting Theater Mechanicus at the Irodori Festival, he suddenly made arrangements to travel here and see it for himself.

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: Just imagine, if that young master finds Theater Mechanicus intriguing, I might even get a large sum of Mora for further development...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He's actually got other reasons for being here...

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: You know what? I've decided! I'm going to do my best out there this time and win glory for Theater Mechanicus!

response.speaker: Komakata
response.text: I mean, we've got a sterling player like you on side. We'll definitely succeed, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah... Hooray... Good luck...
